priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect and use Mirror Image pre-combat.
Cast Arcane Surge as your primary burst initiator, followed immediately by Touch of the Magi (off-GCD).
Use Mana Potion, Blood Fury, Berserking, and offensive Trinkets during the Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi window.
Use Evocation if mana is below 10% and both Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi are on cooldown.
Use Arcane Barrage when you have 4 Arcane Charges and Arcane Salvo stacks have reached 20 (or 25 if Sunfury-aligned).
Cast Arcane Orb to generate Arcane Charges if you have fewer than 3 charges and Touch of the Magi is not immediately ready.
Spend Clearcasting procs on Arcane Missiles to build Arcane Salvo stacks, ideally keeping stacks below 15.
Use Presence of Mind to cast instant Arcane Blasts when at 0 or 1 Arcane Charges to quickly ramp up.
Use Arcane Pulse if you have fewer than 3 Arcane Charges and mana is above 30%.
Cast Arcane Blast as your primary filler while at 4 Arcane Charges during burst or high-mana periods.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 charges if Touch of the Magi is about to expire to benefit from the accumulated damage.
Use Arcane Barrage at 4 charges to dump Arcane Salvo stacks if Arcane Surge or Touch of the Magi is about to end.
Maintain Arcane Charges and avoid using Arcane Barrage unless specifically dumping Salvo stacks or resetting for mana conservation outside of burst.
If the target is about to die, prioritize Arcane Barrage and Arcane Missiles to finish the combat.
Use Counterspell to interrupt enemy spellcasting as needed.
